description: Variation of condition 2, development built in accordance with approved drawings (repositioning of side entrance, retaining existing external walls of rear outbuilding while demolishing internal walls and slabs and existing roof will be replaced with timber pergolas) of Full Planning Permission reference 24/3526 dated 25 February, 2025, for Demolition of existing two-storey rear outbuilding, proposed conversion into 3 bedroom 6 person house in multiple occupation (HMO), erection of two-storey rear extension, rear dormer, linked dormer to outrigger, installation of 2x front roof lights, 2x rooflights to flat roof of rear dormer, 1x rooflight to flat roof of linked dormer, 1x side rooflight to rear dormer, alterations to fenestrations of side elevation, hard and soft landscaping to front and rear, refuse storage to front garden and cycle storage to rear garden.
